#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

HERE=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
ROOT=$(cd "$HERE/../../.." && pwd)
SRC="$ROOT/.omx/vendor/route1-ambertools26-precision-20260905/source-unverified/ambertools26_src/AmberTools/src"
BUILD="$ROOT/.omx/benchmarks/route1-numerical-repair-20260905/precision-build/pbsa"
PREFIX=/home/axie/miniconda3/envs/maple-ambertools
OBJ="$BUILD/obj"
MOD="$OBJ/mod"

mkdir -p "$HERE/patched" "$BUILD/bin" "$BUILD/logs" "$MOD"
find "$OBJ" -type f -delete

cp "$HERE/pristine/pb_write.F90" "$HERE/patched/pb_write.F90"
patch -s -d "$HERE/patched" -p1 < "$HERE/precision-output.patch"

python - "$HERE/patched/pb_write.F90" "$HERE/patched/pb_write_override.F90" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys

source = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
end = source.index("end subroutine prntmd\n") + len("end subroutine prntmd\n")
Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(source[:end] + "\n#endif /*ifndef SANDER*/\n")
PY

python - "$SRC/sander/decomp.F90" "$HERE/patched/decomp_interface.F90" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys

source = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(source[:source.index("\ncontains\n")] + "\nend module decomp\n")
PY

common=(-cpp -c -ffree-line-length-none -fallow-argument-mismatch \
  -I"$SRC/pbsa" -I"$SRC/include" -I"$SRC/lib" -I"$MOD" -J"$MOD")

# Generate exact RC7 module interfaces used by the executable-only objects.
/usr/bin/gfortran "${common[@]}" -O0 "$SRC/pbsa/memory_module.F90" -o "$OBJ/mod-memory_module.o"
/usr/bin/gfortran "${common[@]}" -O0 "$SRC/pbsa/parms.F90" -o "$OBJ/mod-parms.o"
/usr/bin/gfortran "${common[@]}" -O0 "$SRC/pbsa/timer.F90" -o "$OBJ/mod-timer.o"
/usr/bin/gfortran "${common[@]}" -O0 "$SRC/pbsa/sa_driver.F90" -o "$OBJ/mod-sa_driver.o"
/usr/bin/gfortran "${common[@]}" -O0 "$SRC/lib/random.F90" -o "$OBJ/mod-random.o"
/usr/bin/gfortran "${common[@]}" -O0 "$HERE/patched/decomp_interface.F90" -o "$OBJ/mod-decomp-interface.o"
/usr/bin/gfortran "${common[@]}" -O0 "$SRC/pbsa/pb_force.F90" -o "$OBJ/mod-pb_force.o"
/usr/bin/gfortran "${common[@]}" -O0 "$SRC/pbsa/np_force.F90" -o "$OBJ/mod-np_force.o"
/usr/bin/gfortran "${common[@]}" -O0 "$SRC/pbsa/density.F90" -o "$OBJ/mod-density.o"
/usr/bin/gfortran "${common[@]}" -O0 "$SRC/pbsa/egb.F90" -o "$OBJ/mod-egb.o"
/usr/bin/gfortran "${common[@]}" -O0 "$SRC/pbsa/pbsa_lib.F90" -o "$OBJ/mod-pbsa_lib.o"

# Compile the exact RC7 program/driver and its executable-only helpers.
/usr/bin/gfortran "${common[@]}" -O2 "$SRC/pbsa/pbsa.F90" -o "$OBJ/pbsa-full-main.o"
/usr/bin/gfortran "${common[@]}" -O2 "$HERE/patched/pb_write_override.F90" -o "$OBJ/pb_write.o"
for source in pb_read rdparm locmem debug force runmd runmin getcoor pb_chkfrc rdpqr ene egb; do
  /usr/bin/gfortran "${common[@]}" -O2 "$SRC/pbsa/$source.F90" -o "$OBJ/$source.o"
done

objects=(pbsa-full-main pb_write pb_read rdparm locmem debug force runmd runmin getcoor pb_chkfrc rdpqr ene egb)
link_objects=()
for object in "${objects[@]}"; do link_objects+=("$OBJ/$object.o"); done

# libpbsa.so supplies the exact installed AT26 PB/SA computational core.
/usr/bin/gfortran -o "$BUILD/bin/pbsa" "${link_objects[@]}" \
  -L"$PREFIX/lib" -Wl,-rpath,"$PREFIX/lib" -Wl,--no-as-needed \
  -lpbsa -lamber_common -llapack -lblas -lm -Wl,--as-needed
